name: Kaseifu no Misu
source:
My latest housekeeper was a mistake.
She was a real klutz and I exploded with anger when she broke my collection of whatever.
I called my previous two maids in for a fourway (3 maids and 1 master). 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088441.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我新雇的家政妇完全是个错误。
她笨手笨脚，打碎我收藏的某样东西时，我顿时大发雷霆。
于是我把前两任女仆也叫了过来，与三名女仆来了一场四人性爱。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088441.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
